targets.rawSql: SELECT avg((payload->'scenario'->>'raw_proposals_count')::int)::int AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_system' AND type='scenario.completed' AND payload->'scenario'->>'raw_proposals_count' IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(received_at);

SELECT avg((payload->'scenario'->>'merged_count')::int)::int AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_system' AND type='scenario.completed' AND payload->'scenario'->>'merged_count' IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(received_at);

SELECT avg((payload->'scenario'->>'viable_count')::int)::int AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_system' AND type='scenario.completed' AND payload->'scenario'->>'viable_count' IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(received_at);

SELECT avg((payload->'scenario'->>'tickets_shown')::int)::numeric(10,1) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_system' AND type='scenario.completed' AND payload->'scenario'->>'tickets_shown' IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(received_at);

SELECT '1. Raw proposals' AS stage, avg((payload->'scenario'->>'raw_proposals_count')::int)::int AS avg FROM events WHERE service='avia_system' AND type='scenario.completed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) UNION ALL SELECT '2. Merged with AMA' AS stage, avg((payload->'scenario'->>'merged_count')::int)::int AS avg FROM events WHERE service='avia_system' AND type='scenario.completed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) UNION ALL SELECT '3. Viable (rec engine)' AS stage, avg((payload->'scenario'->>'viable_count')::int)::int AS avg FROM events WHERE service='avia_system' AND type='scenario.completed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) UNION ALL SELECT '4. Tickets shown' AS stage, avg((payload->'scenario'->>'tickets_shown')::int)::int AS avg FROM events WHERE service='avia_system' AND type='scenario.completed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) ORDER BY 1;

SELECT (avg(100.0 * (payload->'scenario'->>'tickets_shown')::int / NULLIF((payload->'scenario'->>'raw_proposals_count')::int, 0)))::numeric(10,2) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_system' AND type='scenario.completed' AND payload->'scenario'->>'raw_proposals_count' IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(received_at);

SELECT received_at AS "Время", data AS "Запрос", (payload->'scenario'->>'raw_proposals_count')::int AS "Raw", (payload->'scenario'->>'merged_count')::int AS "Merged", (payload->'scenario'->>'viable_count')::int AS "Viable", (payload->'scenario'->>'tickets_shown')::int AS "Tickets", CASE WHEN (payload->'scenario'->>'raw_proposals_count')::int > 0 THEN round(100.0 * (payload->'scenario'->>'tickets_shown')::int / (payload->'scenario'->>'raw_proposals_count')::int, 2) END AS "% конв." FROM events WHERE service='avia_system' AND type='scenario.completed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT received_at AS "Время", data AS "Запрос", (payload->'scenario'->>'raw_proposals_count')::int AS "Raw", (payload->'scenario'->>'merged_count')::int AS "Merged", (payload->'scenario'->>'nonstop_filter_success')::text AS "nonstop_ok" FROM events WHERE service='avia_system' AND type='scenario.completed' AND (payload->'scenario'->>'viable_count')::int = 0 AND $__timeFilter(received_at) ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 50;
